descriptor: Mōchirīī is an Asia Pacific guild for casual Where Winds Meet players. We organize teams, events, raffles, guides & member projects.
Discord handles onboarding & event planning. The website keeps guild rules, ranks, leaders, updates, screenshots, social posts & forums in one place.

seal.title: Guild Seal
verse: Silvered jade softly gleams, where quiet petals fall,
Bamboo stands in patient grace, a guardian to all.
Hearts gather here in gentle light, unhurried, warm & true,
A seal of trust, of shared resolve, where kindred spirits grew.
